# <!--name-->slack/notify<!--/name-->
<!--description-->
Post a Slack message through the elastic-docs-slack-notifier Lambda.
Requires `permissions: id-token: write` in the calling workflow.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs
<!--inputs-->
| Name      | Description                             | Required | Default |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------|----------|---------|
| `channel` | Slack channel ID or name                | `true`   | ` `     |
| `text`    | Plain text message body                 | `false`  | ` `     |
| `blocks`  | Block Kit blocks as a JSON array string | `false`  | ` `     |
<!--/inputs-->

## Outputs
<!--outputs-->
| Name      | Description                                  |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------|
| `channel` | Slack channel ID from the posted message     |
| `ts`      | Slack message timestamp for threaded replies |
<!--/outputs-->

## Usage
<!--usage action="your/action" version="v1"-->
```yaml
permissions:
  id-token: write

jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: elastic/docs-actions/slack/notify@v1
        with:
          channel: C0123456789
          text: Build finished with status success
```

```yaml
      - uses: elastic/docs-actions/slack/notify@v1
        id: slack
        with:
          channel: C0123456789
          text: Build result
          blocks: |
            [
              {
                "type": "section",
                "text": {
                  "type": "mrkdwn",
                  "text": "*Build succeeded*\nRepo: ${{ github.repository }}"
                }
              }
            ]
```
<!--/usage-->
